source.query:
-- Build 130 acquisition cohort, NOT all users who upgraded to build 130.
-- Set the shared public-launch variable only after App Store release.
WITH first_welcome AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS started,
           argMin(toString(properties.build), timestamp) AS first_build
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND properties.screen_id = 's1'
    GROUP BY person_id
), excluded AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND (properties.is_test_build = true OR properties.onboarding_preview = true
        OR (timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-18 00:00:00')
            AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-21 04:11:22')
            AND toInt(properties.build) BETWEEN 109 AND 116)
        -- Preserve the project's existing Apple-review traffic heuristic.
        OR (properties.build IS NOT NULL AND properties.$geoip_country_code = 'US'
            AND (properties.$geoip_city_name = 'Cupertino'
              OR empty(toString(coalesce(properties.$geoip_subdivision_1_code, ''))))))
), cohort AS (
    SELECT person_id, started
    FROM first_welcome
    WHERE first_build = '130'
      AND notEmpty({variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc})
      AND started >= toDateTime(if(empty({variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc}), '2100-01-01 00:00:00', {variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc}))
      AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM excluded)
), native AS (
    SELECT e.person_id AS person_id, e.timestamp AS ts, e.event AS event,
           e.properties AS p, c.started AS started
    FROM events e JOIN cohort c ON e.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE e.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00')
      AND e.timestamp >= c.started AND e.timestamp <= now()
      AND toString(e.properties.build) = '130'
), onboarding AS (
    SELECT * FROM native WHERE ts < started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
), rc AS (
    -- Deduplicate RevenueCat deliveries by insert_id. Never filter these by build.
    SELECT person_id,
           coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.insert_id), ''), toString(uuid)) AS delivery_id,
           argMax(raw_rc.event, raw_rc.timestamp) AS event, min(raw_rc.timestamp) AS ts,
           argMax(toString(properties.original_transaction_id), timestamp) AS subscription_id,
           argMax(toString(properties.product_id), timestamp) AS product,
           argMax(toString(properties.expiration_at), timestamp) AS expiry,
           argMax(toFloatOrZero(properties.revenue), timestamp) AS usd
    FROM events AS raw_rc
    WHERE raw_rc.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND raw_rc.timestamp <= now()
      AND startsWith(raw_rc.event, 'rc_')
      AND person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort)
    GROUP BY person_id, delivery_id
), acquired_rc AS (
    SELECT r.*, c.started AS started
    FROM rc r JOIN cohort c ON r.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE r.ts >= c.started
), first_trials AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(ts) AS trial_start,
           argMin(subscription_id, ts) AS subscription_id,
           toDateTime(coalesce(nullIf(argMin(expiry, ts), ''), '2100-01-01 00:00:00')) AS trial_end,
           argMin(product, ts) AS product
    FROM acquired_rc
    WHERE event = 'rc_trial_started_event' AND ts < started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY person_id
), trial_outcomes AS (
    SELECT t.person_id AS person_id, t.trial_start AS trial_start,
           t.trial_end AS trial_end, t.product AS product,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event'
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end), toDateTime(0)) AS cancelled_at,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_trial_converted_event'), toDateTime(0)) AS converted_at,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_expiration_event'), toDateTime(0)) AS expired_at,
           countIf(r.event = 'rc_billing_issue_event'
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 14 DAY) > 0 AS billing_issue,
           argMaxIf(r.event, r.ts,
               r.event IN ('rc_trial_cancelled_event', 'rc_uncancellation_event')
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end) = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event' AS renewal_disabled
    FROM first_trials t LEFT JOIN rc r ON t.person_id = r.person_id
         AND t.subscription_id = r.subscription_id
    WHERE r.ts >= t.trial_start
    GROUP BY t.person_id, t.trial_start, t.trial_end, t.product
), page_times AS (
    SELECT person_id,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's1'), toDateTime(0)) AS s1,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's2c'), toDateTime(0)) AS s2c,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's3'), toDateTime(0)) AS s3,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's4'), toDateTime(0)) AS s4,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's4b'), toDateTime(0)) AS s4b,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's5'), toDateTime(0)) AS s5,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's6'), toDateTime(0)) AS s6,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's7'), toDateTime(0)) AS s7,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's8a'), toDateTime(0)) AS s8a,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's8b'), toDateTime(0)) AS s8b,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's8c'), toDateTime(0)) AS s8c,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's9t'), toDateTime(0)) AS s9t,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's11'), toDateTime(0)) AS s11,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'login_form_detected'), toDateTime(0)) AS login_form,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'login_succeeded'), toDateTime(0)) AS connected,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'inbox_reveal_viewed'), toDateTime(0)) AS reveal,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'perks_viewed'), toDateTime(0)) AS perks,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'try_viewed'), toDateTime(0)) AS trial_intro,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'offer_viewed'), toDateTime(0)) AS offer,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'reminder_viewed'), toDateTime(0)) AS reminder,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'paywall_viewed' AND p.screen_id = 's13_paywall'), toDateTime(0)) AS attempt,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'paywall_presented' AND p.paywall_id = 'original' AND p.placement = 'onboarding'), toDateTime(0)) AS paywall,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'purchase_result' AND p.result = 'purchased'), toDateTime(0)) AS accepted,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'notify_answered'), toDateTime(0)) AS notify,
        nullIf(minIf(ts, event = 'onboarding_completed' AND p.screen_id = 's14_success'), toDateTime(0)) AS complete
    FROM onboarding GROUP BY person_id
), payments AS (
    SELECT person_id, countIf(usd > 0 AND event IN ('rc_trial_converted_event','rc_initial_purchase_event')) > 0 AS paid
    FROM acquired_rc GROUP BY person_id
), summary AS (
    SELECT count() AS starters, countIf(p.paywall IS NOT NULL) AS paywalls,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00')) AS trials,
      countIf(t.trial_start >= p.paywall AND p.paywall IS NOT NULL) AS trials_after_paywall,
      countIf(p.accepted >= p.paywall AND p.paywall IS NOT NULL) AS accepted,
      countIf(p.complete IS NOT NULL) AS completed, countIf(r.paid) AS paying,
      countIf(t.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelled,
      countIf(t.converted_at IS NOT NULL) AS converted,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND now() < t.trial_end AND t.converted_at IS NULL AND t.expired_at IS NULL) AS active,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND now() >= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS mature24,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND now() >= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS mature14,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND now() >= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.converted_at <= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS converted24,
      countIf(t.trial_start > toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND now() >= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 14 DAY AND t.converted_at <= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS converted14
    FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN page_times p ON c.person_id = p.person_id
    LEFT JOIN trial_outcomes t ON c.person_id = t.person_id
    LEFT JOIN payments r ON c.person_id = r.person_id
)
SELECT r.2 AS metric, r.3 AS people, r.4 AS denominator, r.5 AS percent
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([
(1, 'New onboarding starters', starters, NULL, NULL),
(2, 'Paywall rate: rendered / starters', paywalls, starters, round(100.0 * (paywalls) / nullIf((starters), 0), 1)),
(3, 'Trial starts / onboarding starters', trials, starters, round(100.0 * (trials) / nullIf((starters), 0), 1)),
(4, 'Trials after rendered paywall / paywall viewers', trials_after_paywall, paywalls, round(100.0 * (trials_after_paywall) / nullIf((paywalls), 0), 1)),
(5, 'Apple accepted purchase / rendered paywall', accepted, paywalls, round(100.0 * (accepted) / nullIf((paywalls), 0), 1)),
(6, 'Final onboarding CTA / starters', completed, starters, round(100.0 * (completed) / nullIf((starters), 0), 1)),
(7, 'Confirmed paying people so far', paying, NULL, NULL),
(8, 'Trials with any renewal cancellation', cancelled, trials, round(100.0 * (cancelled) / nullIf((trials), 0), 1)),
(9, 'Trials converted to paid so far', converted, NULL, NULL),
(10, 'Trials still before scheduled expiry', active, NULL, NULL),
(11, 'Trial-to-paid at expiry + 24h: mature only', converted24, mature24, round(100.0 * (converted24) / nullIf((mature24), 0), 1)),
(12, 'Trial-to-paid at expiry + 14d: mature only', converted14, mature14, round(100.0 * (converted14) / nullIf((mature14), 0), 1))
]) AS r FROM summary) ORDER BY r.1

    SELECT e.person_id AS person_id, e.timestamp AS ts, e.event AS event,
           e.properties AS p, c.started AS started
    FROM events e JOIN cohort c ON e.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE e.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00')
      AND e.timestamp >= c.started AND e.timestamp <= now()
      AND toString(e.properties.build) = '130'
), onboarding AS (
    SELECT * FROM native WHERE ts < started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
), rc AS (
    -- Deduplicate RevenueCat deliveries by insert_id. Never filter these by build.
    SELECT person_id,
           coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.insert_id), ''), toString(uuid)) AS delivery_id,
           argMax(raw_rc.event, raw_rc.timestamp) AS event, min(raw_rc.timestamp) AS ts,
           argMax(toString(properties.original_transaction_id), timestamp) AS subscription_id,

    WHERE raw_rc.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND raw_rc.timestamp <= now()
      AND startsWith(raw_rc.event, 'rc_')

           toDateTime(coalesce(nullIf(argMin(expiry, ts), ''), '2100-01-01 00:00:00')) AS trial_end,

    FROM acquired_rc

    GROUP BY person_id

           t.trial_end AS trial_end, t.product AS product,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event'

               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end) = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event' AS renewal_disabled

    WHERE r.ts >= t.trial_start
    GROUP BY t.person_id, t.trial_start, t.trial_end, t.product

               expired_at IS NOT NULL, 'Expired without recorded conversion',
               now() < trial_end AND renewal_disabled, 'Trial still active; renewal off',
               now() < trial_end, 'Trial still active; renewal on',
               billing_issue, 'Past scheduled expiry; billing issue',
               'Past scheduled expiry; awaiting final outcome') AS state,
       count() AS trials,
       round(100.0 * count() / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM first_trials), 0), 1) AS percent_of_trials
FROM trial_outcomes GROUP BY state ORDER BY trials DESC

-- Build 130 acquisition cohort, NOT all users who upgraded to build 130.
-- Set the shared public-launch variable only after App Store release.
WITH first_welcome AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS started,
           argMin(toString(properties.build), timestamp) AS first_build
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND properties.screen_id = 's1'
    GROUP BY person_id
), excluded AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND (properties.is_test_build = true OR properties.onboarding_preview = true
        OR (timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-18 00:00:00')
            AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-21 04:11:22')
            AND toInt(properties.build) BETWEEN 109 AND 116)
        -- Preserve the project's existing Apple-review traffic heuristic.
        OR (properties.build IS NOT NULL AND properties.$geoip_country_code = 'US'
            AND (properties.$geoip_city_name = 'Cupertino'
              OR empty(toString(coalesce(properties.$geoip_subdivision_1_code, ''))))))
), cohort AS (
    SELECT person_id, started
    FROM first_welcome
    WHERE first_build = '130'
      AND notEmpty({variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc})
      AND started >= toDateTime(if(empty({variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc}), '2100-01-01 00:00:00', {variables.konvo_130_public_launch_utc}))
      AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM excluded)
), native AS (
    SELECT e.person_id AS person_id, e.timestamp AS ts, e.event AS event,
           e.properties AS p, c.started AS started
    FROM events e JOIN cohort c ON e.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE e.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00')
      AND e.timestamp >= c.started AND e.timestamp <= now()
      AND toString(e.properties.build) = '130'
), onboarding AS (
    SELECT * FROM native WHERE ts < started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
), rc AS (
    -- Deduplicate RevenueCat deliveries by insert_id. Never filter these by build.
    SELECT person_id,
           coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.insert_id), ''), toString(uuid)) AS delivery_id,
           argMax(raw_rc.event, raw_rc.timestamp) AS event, min(raw_rc.timestamp) AS ts,
           argMax(toString(properties.original_transaction_id), timestamp) AS subscription_id,
           argMax(toString(properties.product_id), timestamp) AS product,
           argMax(toString(properties.expiration_at), timestamp) AS expiry,
           argMax(toFloatOrZero(properties.revenue), timestamp) AS usd
    FROM events AS raw_rc
    WHERE raw_rc.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-25 00:00:00') AND raw_rc.timestamp <= now()
      AND startsWith(raw_rc.event, 'rc_')
      AND person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort)
    GROUP BY person_id, delivery_id
), acquired_rc AS (
    SELECT r.*, c.started AS started
    FROM rc r JOIN cohort c ON r.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE r.ts >= c.started
), first_trials AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(ts) AS trial_start,
           argMin(subscription_id, ts) AS subscription_id,
           toDateTime(coalesce(nullIf(argMin(expiry, ts), ''), '2100-01-01 00:00:00')) AS trial_end,
           argMin(product, ts) AS product
    FROM acquired_rc
    WHERE event = 'rc_trial_started_event' AND ts < started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY person_id
), trial_outcomes AS (
    SELECT t.person_id AS person_id, t.trial_start AS trial_start,
           t.trial_end AS trial_end, t.product AS product,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event'
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end), toDateTime(0)) AS cancelled_at,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_trial_converted_event'), toDateTime(0)) AS converted_at,
           nullIf(minIf(r.ts, r.event = 'rc_expiration_event'), toDateTime(0)) AS expired_at,
           countIf(r.event = 'rc_billing_issue_event'
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end + INTERVAL 14 DAY) > 0 AS billing_issue,
           argMaxIf(r.event, r.ts,
               r.event IN ('rc_trial_cancelled_event', 'rc_uncancellation_event')
               AND r.ts <= t.trial_end) = 'rc_trial_cancelled_event' AS renewal_disabled
    FROM first_trials t LEFT JOIN rc r ON t.person_id = r.person_id
         AND t.subscription_id = r.subscription_id
    WHERE r.ts >= t.trial_start
    GROUP BY t.person_id, t.trial_start, t.trial_end, t.product
)
SELECT 35 AS age_days,
       (SELECT count() FROM cohort WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 35 DAY) AS mature_starters,
       (SELECT uniqExactIf(person_id, usd > 0) FROM acquired_rc WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 35 DAY AND ts < started + INTERVAL 35 DAY) AS paying_people,
       round(100.0 * paying_people / nullIf(mature_starters, 0), 1) AS starter_to_paid_percent,
       (SELECT round(coalesce(sumIf(usd, usd > 0), 0), 2) FROM acquired_rc WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 35 DAY AND ts < started + INTERVAL 35 DAY) AS gross_usd,
       round(gross_usd / nullIf(mature_starters, 0), 3) AS gross_usd_per_starter
UNION ALL
SELECT 60 AS age_days,
       (SELECT count() FROM cohort WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS mature_starters,
       (SELECT uniqExactIf(person_id, usd > 0) FROM acquired_rc WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 60 DAY AND ts < started + INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS paying_people,
       round(100.0 * paying_people / nullIf(mature_starters, 0), 1) AS starter_to_paid_percent,
       (SELECT round(coalesce(sumIf(usd, usd > 0), 0), 2) FROM acquired_rc WHERE now() >= started + INTERVAL 60 DAY AND ts < started + INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS gross_usd,
       round(gross_usd / nullIf(mature_starters, 0), 3) AS gross_usd_per_starter
